record_title: Degree-sensitive separation for integer linear forms in square roots
provenance: Degree-sensitive refinement of the explicit quantitative square-root linear-independence bound of Aymone, Figueredo and Tafula (arXiv:2609.14161v1), replacing the formal full sign cube by the conjugates of the multiquadratic field generated by the negative active radicands.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The general observation that algebraic dependence can reduce effective degree is classical and appears in earlier separation-bound literature; the claimed contribution is the explicit rank-sensitive formula and its sharp complete-multiquadratic-basis specialization. The full text of Dubickas (2024), DOI 10.1016/j.jco.2024.101866, was not inspected, although bibliographic/abstract metadata and the 2026 primary source's description of its related product argument were inspected; this is the principal residual literature risk. The theorem does not improve the full-rank case and does not resolve the general Sum-of-Square-Roots complexity problem. Numerical checks support examples only and do not replace the proof. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
